caption: The drawing depicts two distinct sections on a beige background. The top section features a colored illustration of a semicircular relief or plaque, shaded in brown and ochre tones. This relief shows a single animal, possibly a cow or bull, standing on a patch of grass. The animal is situated under a tree with drooping branches and broad leaves, while shorter leafy plants or grass fill the foreground and sides. A border of geometric or leaf-like patterns runs along the curved edge of the semicircle. Below this relief, the artist's name, "CHARLOTTE ANGUS," is printed in small, capital letters. The lower section of the drawing contains a simple, unfinished pencil outline of a stand or plinth, rectangular at the base and narrowing upward into a rounded vertical form, but without any color or shading. The two sections are separated by empty space, and the overall composition is vertically aligned with the colored illustration at the top and the pencil outline below.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
